data.name: Stickman Beach Volleyball DELUXE
data.detailed_description:
Be among the stick beach volleyball champions! 

 

The DELUXE Windows version features:

  • Improved graphics using the HDRP rendering pipleine and HDR display outuput support

  • Controller support

  • More varied locations

  • Improved game code

You are a stickman volleyball player! Time for some running and smashing of the ball on a beautiful 3d beach to relax.

Features:

★ 3D levels and stick men

★ Quick match and tournament mode

★ Select your difficulty, and points per game ( 5, 15 or the full 25)

★ quick volleyball match: single match, best out of 2 and best out of 5

★ no confusing things like career options, leveling or multiplayer

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, ARM64
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Big Sur 11.0+
  • Processor: Apple Silicon, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 and Ubuntu 22.04
  • Processor: X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan-capable Nvidia and AMD GPUs
